examples.explanation: After round 1 the lit lamps are [on,on,on]; after round 2 [on,off,on]; after round 3 [on,off,off], so 1 lamp stays on.
With no lamps, none can be on.
The single lamp is flipped once and stays on.

hints: A lamp is flipped once per divisor of its position, so only positions with an odd divisor count end lit.
Odd divisor counts happen exactly for perfect squares.
The answer is the number of squares up to n, i.e. floor(sqrt(n)).
title: 408. Bulb Switcher
